FOREWORD 


This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. 

Novaluron technical is employed in the preparation of insecticidal formulations for agricultural use. It is a chemical 
with pesticide properties, belonging to the class of insecticides called insect growth regulators. 

Novaluron technical is the accepted common name by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 
for  (RS)-1-[3-chloro-4-(1,1,2-trifluoro-2-trifluoromethoxyethoxy)phenyl]-3-(2,6-difluorobenzoyl)urea. The 
empirical and structural formulae and the molecular mass of novaluron are given below: 


Empirical formulae Structure Molecular weight 


a F 
C,,H,CIF,N,O, neren / 1. momo / ` 492.7 
4 


In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the provisions of Insecticides Act, 1968 and 
the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under the Insecticides 
Act and Rules, wherever applicable. 


For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value, 
observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis shall be rounded off in accordance with 
IS 2 : 1960 ‘Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised )’. The number of significant places retained in the 
rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

NOVALURON TECHNICAL — SPECIFICATION 


1 SCOPE 


This standard prescribes the requirements and the 
methods of sampling and test for novaluron technical.

Representative samples of material shall be drawn as

7 TESTS 


7.1 Tests shall be carried out in accordance with the 
method referred in col 4 and 5 of Table 1. 


7.2 Quality of Reagents 


Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and distilled 
water (see IS 1070) shall be employed in tests. 


NOTE — ‘Pure chemical’ shall mean chemicals that do not 
contain impurities which affect the results of analysis.

ANNEX A 
[Table 1] 


DETERMINATION OF NOVALURON CONTENT 


A-1 PRINCIPLE 


To determine novaluron content in novaluron technical, 
high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) 
using reverse phase column, UV detection and external 
standard is used. 


A-2 APPARATUS 

A-2.1 Weighing Balance, least count-0.1 mg. 
A-2.2 Volumetric Flask, 50 ml. 

A-2.3 HPLC with UV Detector 


A-2.4 Chromatographic Parameters 


(For guidance only) 

Instrument High performance liquid 
chromatograph system 
equipped with UV-VIS 
detector and coupled to 
a printer-plotter-cum- 
integrator 

Column Stainless steel, 250 x 4.6 
mm (ID), packed with Sum 
—C18 

Mobile phase Acetonitrile (65 percent), 
Water (35 percent) 

Volume injected 20 ul 

Flow rate (ml/min) 1.5 ml/min 

Wave length (nm) 260 nm 

Run time 12 min 

Retention time 

(Approximately) 

Novaluron 7.9 min 


A-3 REAGENTS 

A-3.1 Acetonitrile — HPLC Grade or equivalent 
A-3.2 Water — HPLC Grade 

A-3.3 Tetrahydrofuran — HPLC Grade or equivalent 


A-3.4 Reference Novaluron Standard of Known 
Purity 


A-4 PROCEDURE 


A-4.1 Outline of the Method 


The technical content of novaluron in technical 
sample is determined by a high performance liquid 
chromatography using reverse phase column, UV 
detection and external standard. 


A-4.2 Preparation of Standard Solution (C) 


Weigh out accurately sufficient sample to contain 
20 mg of novaluron standard of known purity into a 
50 ml volumetric flask. Add 1 ml of tetrahydrofuran to 
dissolve the sample and make up volume to 50 ml with 
acetonitrile (solution C). Mix well. Filter the solutions 
through a 0.2 um PTFE filter prior to analysis. 


A-4.3 Preparation of Sample Solution 


Weigh out accurately sufficient sample equivalent to 
20 mg of novaluron technical into a 50 ml volumetric 
flask. Add 1 ml of tetrahydrofuran to dissolve the 
sample and make up volume to 50 ml with acetonitrile 
(solutions S1). Mix well. Filter the solutions through a 
0.2 um PTFE filter prior to analysis. 


A-4.4 Sample Analysis 
Inject in the sequence C, S1, S1, C, S2, S2.... 
Where, 


C =standard solution, and 


S =sample solution (for example, S1 = sample 1, 
S2 = sample 2...) 


A-5 FORMULA FOR CALCULATION 


H, = Mx P 
Novaluron content (percent w/w) = —————— 
H,x w 
Where, 
H, = Peak area of novaluron, in the standard solution 
Lu V-sec); 
H = Peak area of novaluron, in the sample solution 
Lu V-sec); 
M =Mass of novaluron, in the Standard solution 
(mg); 


w = Mass of sample taken (mg); and 
P = Purity ofnovaluron reference standard (percent).

BIS is a statutory institution established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 to promote harmonious 
development of the activities of standardization, marking and quality certification of goods and attending to 
connected matters in the country.

Review of Indian Standards 


Amendments are issued to standards as the need arises on the basis of comments. Standards are also reviewed 
periodically; a standard along with amendments is reaffirmed when such review indicates that no changes are 
needed; if the review indicates that changes are needed, it is taken up for revision. Users of Indian Standards 
should ascertain that they are in possession of the latest amendments or edition by referring to the latest issue of 
“BIS Catalogue’ and “Standards: Monthly Additions’.
